_about: Heat storage (hot water tank) sized in kWh of heat. TO CHECK: every value is a placeholder until the block is refined.
charge_efficiency_note: share of the heat sent to the tank that is stored. TO CHECK: placeholder
discharge_efficiency_note: share of the stored heat that reaches the greenhouse. TO CHECK: placeholder
power_note: the most heat the tank takes in, and gives out, per hour, per kWh of size (0.25: full in 4 hours). TO CHECK: placeholder

loss.mode_note: constant, seasonal or dynamic (from the outside temperature of the block's input file)
loss.constant_note: share of the stored heat lost per hour, all year. TO CHECK: placeholder
loss.seasonal_note: share lost per hour in each season (winter Dec-Feb, spring Mar-May, summer Jun-Aug, autumn Sep-Nov). TO CHECK: placeholders
loss.dynamic_note: share lost per hour = loss_per_hour_at_ref x (store_temp_c - outside temperature) / (store_temp_c - ref_outside_temp_c), at least 0. TO CHECK: placeholders
